content: Please can SKS point me to where I can learn about how to code for the new HostApi approach? I have seen lines 7230-7241 in the present ocpn_plugin.h but some words about the architecture and its aim as well as example code would be appreciated. Maybe I missed out on discussions about this.
I guess that points to me. However, busy right now... BBL

Hi Tony,

Last commit of the Demo plugin illustrates the use of the new HostAPI model.

Exploring this further. Had some dificulty getting things to compile.
In ocpn_plugin.h lines 7237-7241 we have

extern DECL_EXP std::unique_ptr<HostApi> GetHostApi();

// To gain access to api121, do something like this:
// auto host_api = std::move(GetHostApi());
// auto api_121 = std::dynamic_pointer_cast<HostApi121>(host_api);

Enlisted help from ChatGPT which says as written that code cannot compile with the immediately preceding declaration of GetHostApi()returning std::unique_ptr<HostApi>

Setting things up in my plugin I should use 

std::unique_ptr<HostApi>  m_host_api = GetHostApi();
HostApi121* m_api_121 = dynamic_cast<HostApi121*>(m_host_api.get());

So... a question about whether the std::dynamic_pointer_cast<HostApi121> in the ocpn_plugin.h example is correct?
